title: Numbers At Most N Given Digit Set
summary: Given a sorted array of digits, determine how many positive integers can be formed using these digits that are less than or equal to a specified integer n.
statement: Given a sorted array of digits, determine how many positive integers can be formed using these digits that are less than or equal to a specified integer n.
constraints: digits are distinct and exclude zero; 1 <= n <= 10^9.
Count positive integers at most n using only the supplied digits.
hints: Count shorter lengths before matching n digit by digit.
At each position count allowed digits smaller than n’s digit.
Add smaller-prefix completions; stop if the current digit is unavailable.
Every valid number is classified by length and then its first differing digit.
editorial: Every valid number is classified by length and then its first differing digit.

tests.explanation: There are four one-digit and sixteen two-digit valid numbers.
Every length one through nine is allowed, totaling 29,523.
